en: An old sepia-toned image showing a large public gathering in front of a row of two‑story houses with tiled roofs on a hillside. The foreground features men, women, and children in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century European/Ottoman clothing, along with several horse‑drawn carriages and riders. Behind them, crowds line a raised embankment and balconies, suggesting a parade or ceremonial event. The photograph is worn and stained, typical of early photographic postcards. No legible printed caption is visible.
